about_the_game:
Welcome to DeepBubbles — a dreamy and relaxing underwater world. Raise adorable deep-sea fish, unlock your collection, and gather coins, bubbles, and rare items through active play.

No idle gains — your fish need your attention to grow and thrive.
Perfect for players who enjoy nurturing, collecting, and a calm atmosphere.

Ready to dive in and create your own peaceful underwater world?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 / 8 / 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with OpenGL 3.3 or DirectX 10 support (e.g., Intel HD 4000)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: This is a traditional PC single-player game and does not support virtual reality (VR) devices. A DirectX-compatible sound card is recommended for proper audio output.
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for Steam Cloud saves and leaderboards
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3 and above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GT 1030 / AMD RX 550) or high-performance integrated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: This is a traditional PC single-player game and does not support virtual reality (VR) devices. A DirectX-compatible sound card is recommended for proper audio output.
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for Steam Cloud saves and leaderboards

short_description: A dreamy idle aquarium game set in the deep sea, where players collect, feed, and evolve a variety of fish to build their own underwater paradise. Tap bubbles to release food, attract fish, complete tasks, and relax in a soothing aquatic world.
